en_title: Former BioWare Executive Producer Mark Darrah Says EA Might Be 'More Likely' to Sell IPs Like Mass Effect and Dragon Age After Studio’s Closure
cn_title: 前高管称EA关闭BioWare后或出售IP
subtitle: 传奇工作室落幕
opus_summary: BioWare前执行制作人Mark Darrah表示，EA关闭工作室后，或许更可能出售《质量效应》《龙腾世纪》等IP，但也可能将其雪藏。EA目前侧重控制成本，未来若转向创收，出售闲置IP的可能性或将增加。

paragraphs.en: Mark Darrah, who worked as an Executive Producer at BioWare from 1997–2021, shared his thoughts on the studio’s recent closure by EA and what he thinks might happen to its iconic IPs.
paragraphs.cn: Mark Darrah曾于1997年至2021年担任BioWare执行制作人。他分享了自己对EA近期关闭该工作室的看法，以及对BioWare旗下经典IP未来走向的推测。

paragraphs.en: EA announced a major restructuring in a lengthy statement on October 21. Amid some exciting developments for Sims, Fight Night, and Star Wars fans came the devastating news that BioWare — the studio responsible for beloved series like Mass Effect and Dragon Age — was being shut down .
paragraphs.cn: EA于10月21日在一份篇幅较长的声明中宣布重大重组。在《模拟人生》《拳击之夜》和《星球大战》系列迎来一些令人振奋的消息之际，粉丝也得知了一个沉重消息：负责打造《质量效应》和《龙腾世纪》等知名系列的BioWare即将关闭。

paragraphs.en: “As we focus on these larger opportunities, we've had a small team at BioWare working on early-development for Mass Effect . We've made the decision not to move forward with this development, which means we’re closing the studio and our Edmonton workspace. BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly,” EA’s statement said.
paragraphs.cn: EA在声明中表示：「在专注于这些更大机遇的同时，BioWare一直有一支小团队负责《质量效应》的早期开发。我们决定不再继续这项开发工作，这意味着我们将关闭该工作室及其埃德蒙顿办公场所。BioWare是一家定义了角色扮演游戏类型的传奇工作室，我们并未轻率地作出这一决定。」

paragraphs.en: This news hit the gaming world hard , with fans taking to social media to mourn the developer and send fired staff their well-wishes. But one burning question has risen above the sadness: What does this mean for the future of BioWare’s IPs?
paragraphs.cn: 这则消息令整个游戏界深受打击。粉丝纷纷在社交媒体上悼念这家开发商，并向被解雇的员工送上祝福。但在悲伤之外，一个迫切的问题浮出水面：BioWare旗下IP的未来会怎样？

paragraphs.en: Some fans have urged EA to sell them off to other companies, with CD Projekt Red being a big favorite due to the two studios’ close relationship over the years. And while nothing is certain, Darrah shared some insight as to what’s possible for BioWare’s creations in the wake of this devastating development — and it’s cautiously optimistic.
paragraphs.cn: 一些粉丝敦促EA将这些IP出售给其他公司，其中CDPR因与BioWare多年来关系密切而成为热门人选。尽管目前没有任何事情能够确定，但Darrah分享了BioWare作品在这场沉重变故之后可能迎来的发展方向，而他的看法谨慎地偏向乐观。

paragraphs.en: “Remember BioWare is 100% owned by EA,” he said in a YouTube video . “EA owns all the IPs. They own Dragon Age, they own Mass Effect, they own Jade Empire. That doesn’t change the situation, really, at all. …Now, there’s nobody working on a [BioWare] game, or games, within the EA organization, and chances are there never will be, which might make them more likely to sell off those IPs. But it might also make them more likely to just try to forget that they ever existed and bury them in the vault.
paragraphs.cn: 他在一段YouTube视频中表示：「请记住，BioWare百分之百归EA所有。所有这些IP都属于EA，包括《龙腾世纪》《质量效应》和《翡翠帝国》。这其实完全没有改变现状。……现在，EA内部已经没有人在开发BioWare的游戏了，而且以后可能也不会再有人开发。这或许会让EA更有可能出售这些IP，但也可能让他们更想彻底忘记这些作品曾经存在过，把它们埋进仓库里。」

paragraphs.en: “I think we still are gonna have to wait a little bit before we see if EA has any interest in selling off some of its dormant IPs. Right now, they seem to be in cost control mode. They might start into a revenue-generation mode where selling IPs might be more desirable.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我认为，我们还得再等一段时间，才能知道EA是否有兴趣出售部分沉寂已久的IP。现在，他们似乎处于控制成本的阶段。EA或许会转向创收模式，届时出售IP可能会变得更有吸引力。」

paragraphs.en: It’s worth mentioning that EA was acquired by a consortium of private investors back in August in a mind-boggling $55 billion deal. As part of this acquisition, the investment group was reportedly banking on the hope that artificial intelligence might help cut costs to help manage its debt.
paragraphs.cn: 值得一提的是，EA于今年8月被一家私人投资者财团以550亿美元(约合人民币3674亿元)的惊人价格收购。据报道，作为这笔收购的一部分，该投资集团曾寄希望于人工智能能够帮助削减成本，从而管理其债务。

paragraphs.en: Given the investment group’s massive debt, some fans are curious to know if this means selling off some of BioWare’s beloved IPs to other developers — or perhaps back to BioWare under a different brand. For now, nothing is certain, other than fans and fellow game developers are equally beside themselves as they grapple with the news that Mass Effect 5 might never get made.
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到该投资集团背负的巨额债务，一些粉丝想知道，这是否意味着BioWare旗下的部分知名IP会被出售给其他开发商，或者以不同品牌的形式重新交给BioWare。目前唯一确定的是，粉丝和游戏开发者同行都难以接受这个消息，因为《质量效应5》或许永远不会面世。
